description_en: Checks if a specified directory contains infrequent access or archive storage files, or if a specified file is an infrequent access or archive storage file
description_zh: 查询指定目录下是否包含低频存储和归档存储文件，或者查询指定文件是否为低频存储或归档存储文件
name: GetDirectoryOrFileProperties

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
The absolute path of the directory or file.

The path must start with a forward slash (/) and must be an existing path in the mount target
parameters.help_zh:
指定目录的绝对路径。

必须以正斜线（/）开头，并且是挂载点中真实存在的路径
parameters.name: path

Entry.description_en: The properties of the directory or file

ATime.description_en:
The time when the file was last accessed.

The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard format and is returned in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

This parameter is returned only if Type is set to File
ATime.description_zh:
查询时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

仅当Type为File时，返回该参数

CTime.description_en:
The time when the metadata of the file was last modified.

The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard format and is returned in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

This parameter is returned only if Type is set to File
CTime.description_zh:
元数据修改时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

仅当Type为File时，返回该值参数

HasArchiveFile.description_en:
Indicates whether the directory contains an archive file.

This parameter is returned only if Type is set to Directory.

Valid values:

true: The directory contains at least one archive file.

false: The directory does not contain archive files
HasArchiveFile.description_zh:
是否包含归档存储文件。

仅当Type为Directory时，返回该参数。

包括：

true：包含
false：不包含

HasInfrequentAccessFile.description_en:
Indicates whether the directory contains an Infrequent Access (IA) file.

This parameter is returned only if Type is set to Directory.

Valid values:

true: The directory contains at least one IA file.

false: The directory does not contain IA files
HasInfrequentAccessFile.description_zh:
是否包含低频存储文件。

仅当Type为Directory时，返回该参数。

包括：

true：包含
false：不包含

Inode.description_en: The inode of the file or directory

MTime.description_en:
The time when the file was last modified.

The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard format and is returned in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

This parameter is returned only if Type is set to File
MTime.description_zh:
文件修改时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

仅当Type为File时，返回该参数

Name.description_en: The name of the file or directory

RetrieveTime.description_en:
The time when the last data retrieval task was run.

The time is displayed in the ISO 8601 standard format and is returned in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

This parameter is returned only if Type is set to File
RetrieveTime.description_zh:
距现在最近一次数据取回任务执行的时间。

执行ISO8601标准表示，返回格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

仅当Type为File时，返回该参数

Size.description_en:
The size of the file.

Unit: bytes.

This parameter is returned only if Type is set to File
Size.description_zh:
文件的大小。

单位：字节

仅当Type为File时，返回该参数

StorageType.description_en:
The storage type of the file.

This parameter is returned only if Type is set to File.

Valid values:

Standard: General-purpose NAS file systems

InfrequentAccess: IA storage medium
StorageType.description_zh:
返回文件的数据存储类型。

仅当Type为File时，返回该参数。

包括：

Standard：通用型NAS存储。
InfrequentAccess：低频存储

Type.description_en:
The type of the returned entry.

Valid values:

File: The entry is a file.

Directory: The entry is a directory
Type.description_zh:
返回结果的类型。

包括：

File：文件
Directory：目录
